These indications are just a simple guide. You can format this however you want, just include the information below!

**Describe the bug**
What doesn't work? How did you encounter this error?

**Which version are you using?**
It would be really helpful if you included both of these parameters:
 - Minecraft version: [e.g.: 1.21.4]
 - Datapack version: [e.g.: v2.2.0]
